title: Connect every rendering app component to the design system

facts.note: REPOSITORY-LEVEL precondition, evaluated against the repository tree (not the candidate file): true iff at least one directory with one of these names exists. If false, the rule self-scopes out for the whole repository.
candidate file: component source file by extension
candidate-file match: file path must not lie under any design root

candidate-file match: tests and vendored/build directories are never scanned. Negated globs are matched against the repo-relative path of the candidate; any match excludes. The concrete vendored/build directory names are a declared addition (source says only 'vendored/build directories'); the detector's own list is authoritative.

values: rendering component with no design-root import
facts.note: requires masking literals/comments, detecting closing or self-closing tags, and resolving imports to the design root (bun_design_system_detector)

fires: A .tsx screen outside the design root renders JSX and imports nothing from the design root, while the repository has a design root
An existing, untouched .jsx app component that renders markup has no import of a design token, primitive, component or template, and the repository is assessed
doesNotFire: The repository has no design/, design_system/ or design-system/ directory
The file is a test (*.test.*, *.spec.*) or lives in a vendored/build directory
The module renders no markup (route, handler, data module)
The file is itself inside the design root

given: A repo with a design root and a .tsx/.jsx app component outside it that renders markup
when: any such component is assessed (new, edited, or untouched)
then: It MUST import at least one design-system element (token, primitive, component, or template) from the design root, so no UI surface is disconnected from the shared system.
prefer: Compose UI from the existing design-system template, component, or primitive that owns the required role.
During GREEN: reuse the nearest existing design-system surface; add only the connection the current rendered behavior requires.
During GREEN: if no suitable surface exists, introduce the smallest design-system component that expresses the current need.
avoid: A meaningless design import merely to satisfy connectivity.
A generic component library for hypothetical callers.
Redesigning the screen or migrating unrelated markup.
unless: No design root in the repo (not judged).
Non-rendering modules: routes, handlers, data (not judged).
why: A screen built without the system is where the next one-off style lands. Requiring one design import makes the connection explicit and reviewable.
evidence: bun_design_system_detector reports no rendering component outside the design root lacking a design-root import.
The current behavioral or rendering acceptance passes.
Reviewer confirms the rendered app component is genuinely composed from the design system (the import is used for rendering, not decorative).
verifier_detail: Design root: a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`. The first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`.
Self-scoping: a repository with no design root is not judged; there is no system to connect to yet. Design-root existence is checked on the repository tree, separately from candidate-file matching.
Rendering component: a component source file whose code (literals and comments masked) contains a closing tag or a self-closing element.
Flag rendering component files (.tsx/.jsx) outside the design root that import nothing from it. All qualifying files are judged, not only changed ones.
Never scan test files (`*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`) or vendored/build directories; do not judge non-rendering modules (routes, handlers, data).
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.2.0
Bun realization of core obligation `coder.design.orphan-ui` (statement and metadata.core_obligation)

sharedNodes.text: During GREEN: reuse the nearest existing compliant surface before creating a new one, add only what the current behavior requires, introduce a new element only when no suitable one exists. Do not broaden: no adjacent redesign, no migration of unrelated code, no generic abstractions for hypothetical callers. Prove: the current behavioral acceptance passes.

additions.justification: Auditor required vendored/build exclusions to have defined matching semantics; the source names only 'vendored/build directories'. The detector's own list remains authoritative.

additions.text: Explicit statement that new, edited, and untouched existing components are all assessed.
additions.justification: Clarifies the source's unconditional scope ('no UI surface is disconnected'); removes the previously introduced create/modify gate. Adds no obligation beyond the source.

trace.note: applies to every qualifying component, no change gate
